text:
sam: deploy-bot alerted a POST-merge spike in eu-prod after v4.0.0. Autorevert queued. I'm in a maintenance window but prefer manual scoped rollback.

deploy-bot: AUTOREVERT RECOMMENDED -> metric: p95_latency_eu_gen > 1.2s (now=1.5s). Will autorevert in 4m unless `override:manual` is provided.

rachel: we also had a small migration rolled in the same deploy (index warmup). if we autorevert without handling DB migration it might leave a mismatch. manual please.

ops-lead: Agreed manual. Authorize scoped rollback for canary + 10% prod traffic in EU. Keep change-window note: rollback during open maintenance window only.

oncall-bot: Manual override requested. @ops-lead please confirm within 2m or deploy-bot will proceed with autorevert.

ops-lead: Confirmed. Manual override granted. tagging @devx for release-notes update and customer comms.

devx: I'll freeze release notes and add a short line: "Investigating a regional latency regression; we rolled back EU traffic while we investigate." Will hold final notes until postmortem.

sam: Rollback plan: 1) pin eu route to v3.9.8 for affected service 2) shift prod slice to 10% fallback, 3) rollback canary nodes fully, 4) verify DB migration idempotency, 5) keep pin for 1h then reassess.

rachel: commands ready: 
```
rwctl routes pin --service inference-eu --version v3.9.8 --duration 1h
rwctl traffic set --service inference-eu --region eu --percent 10 --to v3.9.8
./deploy rollback --region eu --scope canary --to v3.9.8
psql -c "select count(*) from migrations where id='2026_03_warmup' and status='applied'"
```

deploy-bot: rollback starts (job_id=rb-20260323-11). streaming: reverting 4/4 canary pods...

support-bot: Draft customer note prepared. Short text and status tag. ready for devx sign-off.

rachel: post-rollback checks: p95_eu=390ms, 99th=820ms, DB migration row exists and status=applied. No schema revert required.

sam: Good. Keeping pin for 1h per ops. Will open Ticket RB-2026-198 for follow-up and repro. devx, please announce to stakeholders and add a note to the release tracker about change-window overlap.

devx: done. release-tracker updated, release notes frozen. I'll coordinate a short postmortem doc and link RB ticket.

ops-lead: thanks. action items: (1) add a presubmit canary check for migration+latency, (2) add a pre-rollout change-window check to block autorevert during migrations, (3) review our autorevert timeout to avoid DB mismatch risk.

rachel: I'll add those to the postmortem draft. Also adding a mitigation: delay migration apply until after traffic stabilizes for 30m in canary.

sam: closing thread. good coordination. will ping ops-lead before unpin.
